compiled_state.description:
## Context
Bug releasable-cankerous-hammerkop locks pytest 9.0.3 because 9.1.0/9.1.1 drop package conftest fixtures (pytest-dev/pytest#14635). pytest 9.2.0 (2026-10-27) fixes that, but patch set 1 of Gerrit change 3160, locked to 9.2.0, failed CI on 2 independent incompatibilities:

1. 6 review-bot tests fail with `AttributeError: 'State' object has no attribute 'config'` (tests/unit/test_review_bot.py lifespan tests, tests/unit/test_review_bot_in_flight.py health tests; CI run 41137997776, all 3 Ubuntu cells). Cause, reproduced locally: 9.2.0's `MonkeyPatch.setattr` records the old value from `target.__dict__` (pytest #14969). starlette `State` stores attributes in `_state` via a custom `__setattr__`, so the old value is recorded as NOTSET and undo DELETES `app.state.config` (module-level, set at import in src/rebar/review_bot/app.py:423). Every later test reading it fails. Upstream: pytest-dev/pytest#15099 (open; PR #15118).
2. The bounded mutation gate fails on every shard: mutmut 3.7.0's stats hook reads `item._nodeid`, which 9.2.0 removed (boxed/mutmut#615, fixed in mutmut 3.8.1). pyproject pins mutmut==3.7.0 with a note to upgrade only with a measured baseline.

## Plan
- Change the review-bot tests to patch `app.state` through a form 9.2.0 undoes correctly (e.g. `monkeypatch.setitem(appmod.app.state._state, "config", ...)` or a fixture that saves and restores), or wait for a pytest release carrying #15099's fix.
- Upgrade mutmut to >=3.8.1 with a measured baseline per the pyproject note.
- Then relax the lock to pytest 9.2.0 (keep the `!=9.1.0,!=9.1.1` exclusion and tests/unit/test_pytest_interleaved_conftest_args.py).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] With pytest 9.2.0 installed, `pytest -q -n 0 -p no:randomly tests/unit/test_review_bot.py tests/unit/test_review_bot_in_flight.py tests/unit/test_review_bot_retrigger.py` exits 0.
- [ ] `python scripts/mutation_gate.py run --base HEAD^ --head HEAD --shard signing` gets past mutmut's stats phase under pytest 9.2.0.
- [ ] uv.lock pins pytest 9.2.0 or later and the Gerrit change is Verified +1.
compiled_state.title: Make the suite and mutation gate pass on pytest 9.2.0
